paper_title: Solving Convex-Concave Problems with $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-4/7})$ Second-Order Oracle Complexity
authors: Lesi Chen, Chengchang Liu, Luo Luo, Jingzhao Zhang
statement: Lower Bounds It would also be important for future works to establish lower bounds for this problem. The key is to carefully design a zero-chain that couples the worse-case instances for both variables x and y. Although tight lower bounds have been proved for first-order minimax optimization (Ouyang and Xu, 2021; Xie et al., 2020; Zhang et al., 2022; Li et al., 2021), this problem remains open for second-order methods.
